source_support: SNL195:019 lists two SH946E low speed brake connecting rods; adjacent assembly includes two 3/4 inch U.S. Standard plain nuts per rod.
SNL6 plan and side assembled views depict short M572 connections as straight. HB104 shows horizontal levers with rods extending forward.

HB188 calls M572 a tube; 1928 SNL calls SH946E a rod. Internal section is not established. Selected 1928 reconstruction uses a nominal solid 19.05mm (3/4 inch) rod with male thread envelopes, an explicit section estimate.
M4133 and M4134 are left and right low speed brake horizontal levers. Original reconstruction in fulcrum_controls02 listed their brake arm coordinates as uncalibrated plan picks.
constraint_diagnosis: Front low-speed brake pin axis is transverse Y and fulcrum pin axis is vertical Z; fork rod axes perpendicular to those pins share only world X when a straight rod connects them.

Front low-speed brake lever eyes lie at Z=625.125 mm and Y=±535.3957 mm. Rear fulcrum eyes in fulcrum_controls02 lay at Z=625.125 mm but differed in Y by +12.371 mm starboard and -3.504 mm port, with different longitudinal stations (dx=47.625 mm starboard vs 31.75 mm port). Rotating forks cannot close a straight rod without transverse and longitudinal alignment.
Bending the rod to retain provisional plan picks was rejected because available figures depict straight rods and SNL specifies two shared SH946E parts.
selected_trial: Reconcile M4134 (Starboard) and M4133 (Port) horizontal lever brake arm profiles symmetrically to brake: [39.6875, -85.3957142857142] and [39.6875, 85.3957142857142]. This centers the longitudinal arm offset at x_b = 39.6875 mm (1-9/16 inch), the exact midpoint between prior Starboard (47.625 mm) and Port (31.75 mm) estimates, adjusting each side symmetrically by ±7.9375 mm (5/16 inch).
Relocate the rear fulcrum joint groups to eye centers [2338.0875, ±535.3957142857142, 625.125] with rotation XYZ(-1,0,0, 0,0,1, 0,1,0), aligning sockets coaxially along -X.

Construct single shared definition Def_RearLowRod (SH946E, 19.05 mm diameter) with 130.7616 mm length (nominal 20.6375 mm insertion per end, satisfying >= 19.05 mm minimum engagement within 25.4 mm socket). Add two linked occurrences of this rod.
Retain front and rear lock nuts (Def_USStdControlNut) seated against socket faces.
limits: Lever arm length, symmetrical arm station, rod section/length and thread representation remain estimates. No motion, strength or full service qualification.
Source SNL6 registration stays fixed. Low-speed rods do not serve as camera-fit anchors.
Front control connections (M573 long rods) and M564 return springs remain pending in subsequent increments.
